body.heading: Where in the world is Sweden?
paragraphs: Sweden is a country in Northern Europe, which is part of Europe.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Sweden is Stockholm.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in Sweden is Swedish.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Sweden is the Swedish krona.

body.heading: How big is Sweden?
paragraphs: Sweden covers about 450,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about twice the size of Romania.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Stockholm spreads over fourteen islands. In Gamla Stan's cobbled lanes stands the Royal Palace, and the Vasa museum holds a whole 17th-century warship.
Abisko National Park in Swedish Lapland sits in a rain shadow that clears the sky — one of the best places on Earth to watch the northern lights.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Sweden on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?

takeaway: Sweden in one breath: a country in Northern Europe, capital Stockholm, where people speak Swedish and pay with the Swedish krona.
